patch.value: Six features provide native investigation context, exact contradiction witnesses, bounded resumes, conditional recovery, and safe packed commands with all release gates passing.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implements companion item pm-cli-website-f4zp; companion read only. Work stays local, release disabled, main scaffold only. Plan: native records and conditional owner revision; derived matrices; deterministic requests; bounded packets; exhaustive interleaving/crash tests and public incident proof.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof passed 6/6: disabling contradiction elimination, withdrawal, alternative acknowledgment, split ranking, output budget, or explicit expected-revision refusal makes its dedicated real-tracker assertion fail. Each source file was restored byte-for-byte. Seven linked tracker checks passed through pm test; strict health reports 10/10 checks, no warnings.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final npm release:check passed all 12 stages on implementation 3f2b058 with an isolated HOME, disabled global/system Git configuration, 137/137 suite tests and 2/2 packed npm/npx and Bun/bunx journeys. Coverage is 100% statements/branches/functions/lines across all 17 inventoried source files, 58 documented declarations, zero lint/duplication/identity violations, zero production vulnerabilities, and a 35-file allowlisted pack. Bun release:check is running on the same code. Release notes were generated by pm-changelog; scaffold history prefixes are intact.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final Bun release:check also passed all 12 stages: 137/137 suite tests, 2/2 packed installation journeys, no skipped/cancelled/todo tests, and 100% in every coverage dimension for every inventoried file. npm and Bun ran sequentially with isolated HOME and Git configuration. Code is 3f2b058; remaining changes are tracker receipts only. Main has the scaffold commit; no remote exists and no push, release or publication was attempted. Remote backend certification is tracked by blocked pm-hypothesis-backend.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Post-gate verification: npm run test:revert passed 6/6 again on the final implementation, npm run typecheck passed after exact source restoration, and production source bytes still match 3f2b058. All seven work claims are released, items remain unclosed for orchestrator review, and strict health passes 10/10 checks with zero warnings. Final commit adds tracker receipts and regenerated changelog only.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Resuming PR #1 review repair. Reusing package features for source/owner admission CAS, byte-exact reusable identities with inert display fields, and restoration paths that recover conclusions. Public PR exists; pull was fast-forward and clean. Will push the same branch, run local gates and verify CI without thread replies, mentions or merges.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: PR #1 repair is ready for CI: source admission uses SDK source leases plus revision comparisons under fencing through the owner CAS; reusable identity values stay exact under lossless scoped transport; show restores every omitted matrix/resume field including long conclusions. Nine behavioral revert proofs passed; source shape, deletion, no-op retry, native renderer and restore-command regressions are green. Typecheck, lint, 66 documented declarations and zero duplication pass. The complete local gate is running; CI release gates will certify the pushed head. Claims are released for orchestrator review without closing items.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final review repair verification: all 10 behavioral revert proofs passed and restored sources exactly; typecheck, ESLint, zero duplication and 66 documented declarations pass. CI is being rerun on the final source-intent/cleanup commit. Four focused linked pm tests passed. Public-data packet is now 1397 estimated tokens, with the same 37913-byte / 9479-token full transcript and explicit five-row omission receipt. No thread replies, mentions, merges or releases.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-2 admission-CAS class: one immutable invocation read set now covers owner native revision, all hypothesis and observation sources, prepared records and no-op results. All automatic owner rebasing is removed. Typecheck, lint, duplication at zero, and 65/65 declaration docstrings pass. Five focused regression tests and the prior 49-test focused suite passed; the full 1,104-schedule combined matrix and native crash/recovery suite are running. Existing real-data and lossless rendering/restoration proofs are retained. CI release gates will verify the pushed head.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-3 changes: source plans are read-only; open and every owner/source mutation now submit one public SDK multi-item batch with the owner CAS first. Captured owner/source versions are validated before semantics, preview, commit, and the prepared transition. Existing source leases remain fenced through the batch; no per-path retry or precreation remains. Current native type, canonical id, parent, payload schema, provenance and withdrawal/closure are checked for admission and every decision read. Invalid sources supply no witnesses or next splits and block conclusion. Historical decisions are retained with explicit validity; bounded issue receipts restore through show. Real-data rerun retained 5 hypotheses, 10 observations, 1397 packet tokens, 37913 transcript bytes/9479 tokens, 56 API calls plus one public GitHub read. Typecheck, lint, zero duplication (0/3404 lines), 69 documented declarations over 18 sources pass. No release or merge performed.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional local gates: npm pack --dry-run contains 39 allowlisted files and no other files; production audit reports zero vulnerabilities. Strict tracker health with extension loading disabled passes all ten checks. Normal local health reports only an ignored pm-github installation built against SDK 2026.10.25 while this task deliberately pins 2026.10.24; no dependency pin or installed extension was changed. Fresh CI has no ignored extension installation and will run the normal strict health gate. Source leases are acquired after the SDK workspace writer to avoid recovery lock inversion. A fresh per-invocation transaction nonce prevents a peer committed journal from bypassing prepared-time validation; stable domain ids still make fresh invocations idempotent. The SDK batch provides journaled logical atomicity with append-only compensation for unexpected storage failure, not physical rollback of arbitrary I/O failures; documented crash recovery treats incomplete native sources as invalid until a fresh conditional repair completes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-4 review: use native ordered-batch preview on the exact committed batch, freeze schema/status registries with the owner/source snapshot, compare complete declarations on replay, preserve all structured data fields, and retain superseded recovery attempts using revision-bound transaction identities. Read issues 5 and 6 including owner verification comments: their original reproductions already pass on this branch; extend their regressions instead of claiming new fixes without evidence. The new instruction explicitly requires SDK 2026.10.25, superseding the original 2026.10.24 pin for the native validation path. No upstream tracker or issue writes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: SDK verification: published 2026.10.25 still rejects managed dependency symlinks during preview. Public SDK PR 1595 shipped after that daily release and fixes preview exclusion with an explicit unresolved-constraints receipt; verified its implementation in the 2026.10.26 artifact. Using 2026.10.26 is necessary to obey native preview validation and preserve packed npm/Bun operation. The package will pin that minimum instead of restoring the rejected parsing-only workaround. Read upstream issue 1597 in full: no public journal abandonment API exists. New attempt ids will bind canonical intent and captured preconditions, with package-owned runtime attempt lineage; no SDK journal is inspected or rewritten.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Native preview integration now uses pm SDK 2026.10.26: 2026.10.25 preview rejects managed extension executable symlinks; the subsequent public release adds the derived-dependency exclusion while retaining native lifecycle validation. Thirteen fixed/native validation cases pass, including required Test fields, missing Test type, withdrawn source admission, declaration digests, exact public data, first-attachment recovery, and authoritative unbounded field reads. Full model and release verification remain in progress.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round-4 implementation complete pending exact-head PR release verification. Native preview and commit use the identical batch; caller-required schema snapshots prevent fresh registry reads from replacing captured preconditions. Machine data is exact, human controls serialize reversibly, and show restores all omitted content. Fixed/native regressions and cheap gates pass; 20 source files, 74 documented declarations, zero duplication, 47 allowlisted package files, zero production audit findings. Packed npm/npx and Bun/bunx journeys passed; public proof remains 1397 resume tokens versus 37913 transcript bytes (9479 tokens), 56 API calls and one GitHub read. Public SDK 2026.10.26 is necessary for native preview with managed extension dependencies; journal lifecycle API gap remains unbraind/pm-cli#1597. PR 1 will provide final-source full release evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: First final-head CI reports 1622 of 1622 tests passing and identifies exactly two unexecuted branch outcomes, in withdrawn-intent replay and create-only embedded intent framing. Added both regression scenarios plus early malformed-Unicode admission refusal required by the native transport. No coverage threshold or source scope changed. PR release gate will be rerun on the follow-up commit; all three focused tests and the new behavioral reversion pass locally.
